scope: Offline CPU-only Gen7 supplied reservation quarantine bookkeeping, no real native backing/mapping qualification.

semantics: Fixed32 private entries hold borrowed actual NativeAdrenoMemory pointers, canonical existing decoded request, supplied start/backing/reservation bytes and validated extent. No object methods are called or pointer/address accessors returned.

All overlap checks use full reservation length including the unbacked tail. Supplied GMU-space32 bounds/VA alignment are checked without selecting a start; CPU pointer alias checks are a separate address space.

Key is kind+GMU request handle. Except a valid message-header change, changed raw request, descriptor or range refuses. Same descriptor/overlapping CPU descriptor object under another key refuses. Capacity32 and integer/metadata/output aliases refuse.

Local failure preserves the first signed64 adapter error and keeps the entire reservation recorded. Duplicate failed retries refuse, no reset/release APIs exist and destructor calls no native cleanup.

A ledger slot/index is CPU metadata, never a device/HFI handle. Summary/copyFailure expose no pointer/range. Native attempted/status available/mapping complete/runtime complete remain0 and all recorded native status is unknown.

The ledger does not acquire references, validate native backing, quarantine hardware or prevent an external caller from releasing it. The real owner must actually retain descriptor/backing/range for the ledger lifetime. No hardware lease follows from caller input or range checks.
result.host_scope: Tests seed only CPU integer-interval metadata with deliberately unbacked real NativeAdrenoMemory class objects. Scalar IOReturn shim only, no object/allocator/provider success doubles. Metadata indexes are not successful device addresses; no address is selected or output and no native method runs.
limits: Fully unattended and no new device execution authorization. No native allocation/cache/provider/VM/SMMU map/unmap or native getter/method execution, USB/phone/SMEM/MMIO/SCM/PAS/power/clock/reset/IOVA/GPU operations. Selected code is compile-only.

A supplied range/index and typed native object are not real reservation, device reference, context/route/VMA/domain/permissions/stop/DMA proof. No address selection/export, HFI hosthandle/ACK or successful allocator/mapping/address model.
Do not repeat new ledger4 source/2 absent-API/5 independent-target or prior extent/map-retention/visibility/HFI/CPU suites. Only actual new internal composition checks.
No query/HFI/272B/ZORNGQF1/normal-log field/fragment/carrier or EFI/Darwin pointer change; both unapplied native VM/GMU patches stay unapplied. No live VM layout change or whole-kernel qualification.
